definitions.note: a phrase standing for the noun: the thing a hiker carries

parts.note: to endorse a plan is to back it
a pack is a full set of playing cards

explanation.surface: Someone signs the back of their playing cards before setting off on a walk.
explanation.definitionFit: A rucksack strapped to the shoulders is the standard load borne by walkers on a trek.

clue.text: Local office out on a limb?

definitions.meaning: a local outlet of a bank or firm, away from head office
a bough grows out from a tree's limb, literally out on it

explanation.definitionFit: A firm's local outlet and a tree's offshoot both share this name for a division off a main trunk.

parts.note: CO is short for company, a business
a gent is a gentleman, a man

explanation.surface: A tycoon is described as a strong figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'businessman' reads as one word, but splits into business (CO) and man (GENT).
explanation.definitionFit: A cogent argument is forceful and convincing, so it is powerful in the persuasive sense.

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quietly
grim as in grim determination, resolute

explanation.surface: A determined traveller slips away quietly.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilgrim journeys on foot to a holy place, so is a traveller or wayfarer.

clue.text: Light boat providing cover for sea-creature

definitions.meaning: a small, flimsy craft such as a canoe
the hard outer casing of a shellfish found on beaches

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the shell of a small bivalve mollusc and, by extension, any tiny frail boat.

indicators.note: inside says the first container sits within the second

parts.note: a second container, here a vat or large tank
a can is a tin container

explanation.surface: One box nested in another turns out to be empty.
explanation.definitionFit: Something vacant is empty, with nothing occupying it.

indicators.note: converting means changing into another form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A holy man is busy converting a spiritual sceptic.
explanation.definitionFit: An animist believes that natural objects have souls, so is a believer in souls everywhere.

parts.note: F is forte, the musical direction for loud
voluble speakers talk easily, being fluent

explanation.surface: Someone talks loudly and at length while their face reddens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flush' suggests a red face, but it is the informal sense of having plenty of money.
explanation.definitionFit: Being flush is slang for having plenty of money, so wealthy.

clue.text: Attempt to include a singlet in disguise

indicators.note: to include means to take the following words inside

parts.note: to have a try is to make an attempt
a singlet is a sleeveless undershirt, a vest in British English

explanation.surface: Someone tries to wear an undershirt as part of a costume.
explanation.definitionFit: A travesty is a mockery that presents something in a distorted form, a grotesque disguise of the real thing.

parts.note: divine means heavenly, like an angel
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A herb is praised as a heavenly thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Angelica is an aromatic plant whose stems are candied, so a herb.

clue.text: A fib about artillerymen in part of Nigeria once

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, the British army's gunners

explanation.surface: Someone tells a small lie concerning gunners stationed in West Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges AFIB into BIAF; 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Biafra was a breakaway region of south-eastern Nigeria from 1967 to 1970.

definitions.meaning: to check something is to restrain or regulate it
a joystick is a hand-held lever for steering a game or plane

explanation.definitionFit: A joystick is a steering device on an aircraft, and to check something is to restrain or regulate it.

clue.text: Time when one is out of work

definitions.text: Time when one is out of work

parts.words: Time when one is out of work
parts.note: reads like a period of unemployment, but means hours free from one's job

explanation.definitionFit: Free time spent away from the job, used for relaxation, is the meaning described.

parts.note: the cost of keeping clothes clean: the charge for washing them

explanation.definitionFit: The charge from a washing service for clean clothes is literally what cleanliness costs.

indicators.note: ordering means putting into a new arrangement, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Tom is questioned about wartime air-raid drills.
explanation.walkthrough: 'air-raid precaution' suggests the Blitz, but the raiders are biting insects.
explanation.definitionFit: A mesh hung over a bed guards against biting insects attacking from the air, a playful air-raid precaution.

indicators.note: starting means only the opening letter of the word is used

parts.note: lawless means having no laws or rules

explanation.surface: A foreigner who arrives ignoring regulations seems spotless.
explanation.definitionFit: Flawless means without any fault or flaw, which is to say perfect and unblemished.

parts.note: sounds like a coloured box, but means what holds a yolk and albumen

explanation.definitionFit: The outer casing of a hen's egg holds both the yolk and the white.

definitions.meaning: tipsy, a little giddy from drink
having fair, pale-coloured hair on the head

explanation.definitionFit: The word means giddy or tipsy, and read literally describes someone with fair hair.

clue.text: Coach and carriages about to turn up

parts.note: a train is a line of railway carriages

indicators.note: in a down clue, to turn up means read the word from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: re is Latin for about or concerning

explanation.surface: A coach and railway carriages are about to appear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to turn up' reverses RE into ER.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainer coaches athletes, so is a coach.

clue.text: He draws when one is open-mouthed

definitions.text: He draws when one is open-mouthed

parts.words: He draws when one is open-mouthed
parts.note: sounds like an artist sketching amazed onlookers, but draws means pulls teeth from a gaping patient

explanation.definitionFit: A tooth doctor extracts teeth while the patient sits with mouth wide open.

indicators.note: up as in messed up, so the letters are mixed

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A building firm cuts up some wall plaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Stucco is fine plaster used to coat walls or make mouldings.

parts.note: jet is a deep black stone, hence jet black
SAM stands for surface-to-air missile

explanation.surface: A dark weapon gets tossed off a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Jetsam is cargo deliberately cast off a ship to lighten it, so something thrown overboard.

clue.text: Cry about donkey at festive occasion

indicators.note: about means going around, so the cry surrounds the animal

parts.note: to wail is to cry out
an ass is a donkey

explanation.surface: A donkey brays loudly at a Christmas party.
explanation.definitionFit: A wassail is a festive drinking party, especially at Christmas.

clue.text: Greatest current asset of the People's Republic

definitions.text: Greatest current asset of the People's Republic

parts.words: Greatest current asset of the People's Republic
parts.note: reads like a balance sheet, but current is the flow of a river, China's longest

explanation.definitionFit: China's longest river is its greatest flowing current, a playful sense of asset.

parts.note: not to throw away, but the actors leave the stage, a script's stage direction

explanation.definitionFit: This Latin stage direction tells several actors to leave the stage, so the cast go off.

clue.text: Such confusion enveloping bird in large flower

indicators.note: enveloping means wrapping round, so the jumbled word surrounds the bird
confusion means the letters are thrown into disorder

parts.note: an ibis is a long-billed wading bird

explanation.surface: Muddle surrounds a bird perched in a big bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confusion' turns SUCH into HCUS, split H...CUS around IBIS; 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Hibiscus is a shrub with large showy trumpet-shaped blooms.

parts.note: South, S, is one of the four players at bridge

indicators.note: confused means the letters are muddled

explanation.surface: A card player in a hot room is honestly bewildered.
explanation.definitionFit: Sultry weather is hot and humid, so sweltering.

clue.text: May be used by speakers at station?

definitions.text: May be used by speakers at station?

parts.words: May be used by speakers at station?
parts.note: a raised stage for orators, and also where rail passengers stand

explanation.definitionFit: A raised stage for orators and the raised area beside railway tracks share this name.
